option.DuplicateAction.label: Duplicate Action
option.DuplicateAction.description:
What to do with duplicate files once a duplicate set is found:
• Move & Rename — move duplicates into _duplicates_ and rename them after the kept copy (or the first duplicate found, if Keep Which Copy is 'None'), plus a number, e.g. foo_1.png, foo_2.png
• Move — move duplicates into _duplicates_ keeping their original filenames
• Delete — send duplicates straight to the Recycle Bin

option.SideloaderModpack.label: Sideloader Modpack
option.SideloaderModpack.description:
How to handle Sideloader Modpack mods:
• Skip — ignore modpack GUIDs entirely; only download non-modpack mods
• Only Used — download missing modpack mods that are actually used by installed cards
• All — download every GUID in the modpack index that is not installed locally
option.SideloaderModpack.case.Skip.label: Skip
option.SideloaderModpack.case.All.label: All
option.TelegramSource.label: Telegram Source
option.TelegramSource.description:
Where to look for mods not covered by BetterRepack:
• No — don't use Telegram at all
• koikatsucards.com — look up each GUID there and download the linked Telegram message
• Telegram Chat Links — search the chats/channels below directly for a file matching the GUID
• koikatsucards.com + Telegram Chat Links — try koikatsucards.com first, then fall back to Telegram Chat Links for anything it couldn't find

Any Telegram option requires a Telegram account: on first use KKAFIO opens https://my.telegram.org for your API ID/Hash, then asks for your phone number and verification code. Credentials are saved in %APPDATA%/KKAFIO/config/telegram.json.
option.TelegramSource.case.No.label: No
option.TelegramSource.case.Both.label: koikatsucards.com + Telegram Chat Links
option.TelegramChatLinks.label: Telegram Chat Links
option.TelegramChatLinks.description: One Telegram channel/group/chat link per line, used when Telegram Source is 'Telegram Chat Links' or the combined option. You must already be a member of each one. Add a topic ID (e.g. .../299) to search only that forum topic; a trailing '# comment' is ignored. Chats are tried in order, moving to the next one if a chat has no match.

'#'-comment lines are ignored too.
